# Switch

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Select one value from a list using an index (0, 1, 2...). With blend enabled, smoothly interpolate between values for animation effects.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/switch",
  "type": "SwitchOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/switch').par.values` (an input) and `op('/switch').out.value` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.values`, `out.value`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `values` | `ListField` | `[]` |
| `index` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `blend` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `value` | `DataField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
